examples.hi: एक आदमी बाहर आपका इंतज़ार कर रहा है।

examples.en: He is a kind man.
examples.hi: वह एक दयालु आदमी है।

examples.en: Three men were working on the road.
examples.hi: तीन आदमी सड़क पर काम कर रहे थे।

examples.en: The old man lives alone.
examples.hi: बूढ़ा आदमी अकेला रहता है।

examples.en: Who is that man in the blue shirt?
examples.hi: नीली शर्ट वाला वह आदमी कौन है?

common_mistake.wrong: There were five mans in the room.
common_mistake.right: There were five men in the room.
common_mistake.why: The plural of 'man' is irregular: 'men'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ at the counter helped me.

en_def: an object, idea, or event; used when you don't name something exactly
hi_nuance: 'Thing' begins with the soft 'th' /θ/, not Hindi 'थ'. 'Things' can mean 'the situation': 'How are things?'. Hindi 'बात' is often 'thing': 'one more thing'.

examples.en: What is this thing on the table?
examples.hi: मेज़ पर यह क्या चीज़ है?

examples.en: I have a lot of things to do today.
examples.hi: मुझे आज बहुत से काम करने हैं।

examples.en: The important thing is to stay calm.
examples.hi: ज़रूरी बात यह है कि शांत रहें।

examples.en: How are things at work?
examples.hi: काम पर सब कैसा चल रहा है?

examples.en: One more thing before you go.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले एक और बात।

common_mistake.wrong: Pack all your things and luggages.
common_mistake.right: Pack all your things and luggage.
common_mistake.why: 'Luggage' is uncountable; there is no 'luggages'.

cloze.sentence: There is one ____ I forgot to mention.

en_def: an adult female human
hi_nuance: Singular /ˈwʊmən/ but plural 'women' is /ˈwɪmɪn/ — the first vowel changes. Use 'women' not 'womans' or 'ladies' in formal writing.

examples.en: A woman called while you were out.
examples.hi: जब आप बाहर थे तब एक महिला ने फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: She is a strong woman.
examples.hi: वह एक मज़बूत महिला है।

examples.en: Many women work in this office.
examples.hi: इस ऑफ़िस में बहुत सी महिलाएँ काम करती हैं।

examples.en: The woman in red is my aunt.
examples.hi: लाल कपड़ों वाली महिला मेरी मौसी हैं।

examples.en: Women's Day is on 8 March.
examples.hi: महिला दिवस 8 मार्च को होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Two womans were talking near the gate.
common_mistake.right: Two women were talking near the gate.
common_mistake.why: The plural of 'woman' is 'women'.

cloze.sentence: That ____ is our new manager.

en_def: the state of being alive; the way someone lives; the period from birth to death
hi_nuance: Plural is 'lives' (/laɪvz/). 'In my life' vs 'in life' — 'Never in my life' is a strong expression. 'Life' is uncountable when general: 'Life is short'.

examples.en: Life in a big city is busy.
examples.hi: बड़े शहर में ज़िंदगी व्यस्त होती है।

examples.en: She has lived here all her life.
examples.hi: वह अपनी पूरी ज़िंदगी यहीं रही है।

examples.en: The doctors saved his life.
examples.hi: डॉक्टरों ने उसकी जान बचाई।

examples.en: Work-life balance is important.
examples.hi: काम और जीवन का संतुलन ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Many lives were lost in the flood.
examples.hi: बाढ़ में कई जानें गईं।

common_mistake.wrong: The life is very hard in Mumbai.
common_mistake.right: Life is very hard in Mumbai.
common_mistake.why: 'Life' in general takes no article.

cloze.sentence: He spent his whole ____ in this village.

en_def: a young person; a son or daughter
hi_nuance: Plural 'children' (/ˈtʃɪldrən/) — 'childs' does not exist, and 'childrens' is wrong. 'Kids' is the informal word. 'Small children', not 'small childs'.

examples.en: She has one child.
examples.hi: उसका एक बच्चा है।

examples.en: The children are playing in the park.
examples.hi: बच्चे पार्क में खेल रहे हैं।

examples.en: I loved cricket as a child.
examples.hi: बचपन में मुझे क्रिकेट बहुत पसंद था।

examples.en: This film is not for children.
examples.hi: यह फ़िल्म बच्चों के लिए नहीं है।

examples.en: Every child needs love.
examples.hi: हर बच्चे को प्यार की ज़रूरत है।

common_mistake.wrong: How many childrens do you have?
common_mistake.right: How many children do you have?
common_mistake.why: 'Children' is already plural.

cloze.sentence: Every ____ in the class got a prize.

en_def: the earth and all the people and things on it
hi_nuance: Always 'the world', with the article. The vowel is /ɜː/ as in 'bird', and the 'r' is not pronounced in British English: /wɜːld/. 'In the world' is used for superlatives: 'the best in the world'.

examples.en: It is the tallest building in the world.
examples.hi: यह दुनिया की सबसे ऊँची इमारत है।

examples.en: She wants to travel around the world.
examples.hi: वह दुनिया घूमना चाहती है।

examples.en: The world is changing fast.
examples.hi: दुनिया तेज़ी से बदल रही है।

examples.en: English is spoken all over the world.
examples.hi: अंग्रेज़ी पूरी दुनिया में बोली जाती है।

examples.en: Welcome to the world of cybersecurity.
examples.hi: साइबर सुरक्षा की दुनिया में आपका स्वागत है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is best player in world.
common_mistake.right: He is the best player in the world.
common_mistake.why: Superlatives and 'world' both need 'the'.

cloze.sentence: There are about two hundred countries in the ____.

en_def: a place where children go to learn
hi_nuance: 'Go to school' (no article) = attend as a student; 'go to the school' = visit the building. No vowel before 'sc': 'school', not 'ischool'.

examples.en: My daughter goes to school by bus.
examples.hi: मेरी बेटी बस से स्कूल जाती है।

examples.en: School starts at eight.
examples.hi: स्कूल आठ बजे शुरू होता है।

examples.en: I went to the school to meet her teacher.
examples.hi: मैं उसकी शिक्षिका से मिलने स्कूल गया।

examples.en: We were friends at school.
examples.hi: हम स्कूल में दोस्त थे।

examples.en: There is no school on Sunday.
examples.hi: रविवार को स्कूल नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: My son goes to the school every day.
common_mistake.right: My son goes to school every day.
common_mistake.why: When 'school' means the activity of studying, no article is used.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ did you go to?

en_def: a group of people related to each other, such as parents and children
hi_nuance: 'Family members' is fine; 'my family people' is not. 'Cousin brother/sister' is an Indianism — just say 'cousin'. 'Family' can take 'is' or 'are'.

examples.en: I have a small family.
examples.hi: मेरा परिवार छोटा है।

examples.en: My family lives in Gujarat.
examples.hi: मेरा परिवार गुजरात में रहता है।

examples.en: We are having a family dinner on Sunday.
examples.hi: रविवार को हमारे परिवार का डिनर है।

examples.en: How is your family?
examples.hi: आपका परिवार कैसा है?

examples.en: Family is more important than money.
examples.hi: पैसे से ज़्यादा परिवार महत्वपूर्ण है।

common_mistake.wrong: My cousin brother lives in Canada.
common_mistake.right: My cousin lives in Canada.
common_mistake.why: 'Cousin' already covers it; 'cousin brother' is Indian English.

cloze.sentence: Tell me about your ____.

en_def: a person who is studying at a school, college, or university
hi_nuance: Starts with /st/ — no vowel before it. 'A student of' + subject, or 'a student at' + institution. 'Studying' is the activity; 'student' is the person.

examples.en: She is a student at Gujarat University.
examples.hi: वह गुजरात विश्वविद्यालय की छात्रा है।

examples.en: The students are taking an exam.
examples.hi: छात्र परीक्षा दे रहे हैं।

examples.en: I was a good student at school.
examples.hi: मैं स्कूल में एक अच्छा छात्र था।

examples.en: There are forty students in the class.
examples.hi: कक्षा में चालीस छात्र हैं।

examples.en: Students get a discount here.
examples.hi: यहाँ छात्रों को छूट मिलती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am a student of B.Tech in this college.
common_mistake.right: I am a B.Tech student at this college.
common_mistake.why: Say what kind of student you are before the noun, and use 'at' for the institution.

cloze.sentence: Every ____ must bring an ID card.

en_def: a number of people or things that are together
hi_nuance: 'A group of' + plural: 'a group of friends'. 'Group' can take 'is' or 'are'. In Indian English 'group' is also used for WhatsApp groups — that's fine.

examples.en: A group of students visited the museum.
examples.hi: छात्रों का एक समूह संग्रहालय गया।

examples.en: Please add me to the WhatsApp group.
examples.hi: कृपया मुझे व्हाट्सएप ग्रुप में जोड़ें।

examples.en: We worked in groups of four.
examples.hi: हमने चार-चार के समूहों में काम किया।

examples.en: She joined a reading group.
examples.hi: वह एक पठन समूह में शामिल हुई।

examples.en: The group leaves at nine.
examples.hi: समूह नौ बजे निकलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: A group of peoples came to the office.
common_mistake.right: A group of people came to the office.
common_mistake.why: 'People' is already plural.

cloze.sentence: Let's split the class into three ____.

en_def: a nation with its own government; land outside cities
hi_nuance: Vowel is /ʌ/ as in 'cup', not 'count'. Plural 'countries'. 'The country' can also mean rural areas: 'live in the country'.

examples.en: India is a large country.
examples.hi: भारत एक बड़ा देश है।

examples.en: Which country are you from?
examples.hi: आप किस देश से हैं?

examples.en: She has visited ten countries.
examples.hi: उसने दस देशों की यात्रा की है।

examples.en: My grandparents live in the country.
examples.hi: मेरे दादा-दादी गाँव में रहते हैं।

examples.en: It is the biggest company in the country.
examples.hi: यह देश की सबसे बड़ी कंपनी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have visited many countrys.
common_mistake.right: I have visited many countries.
common_mistake.why: Nouns ending in consonant + y take '-ies' in the plural.

cloze.sentence: Japan is a ____ in Asia.

en_def: something difficult that needs to be solved
hi_nuance: Stress on the first syllable: PROB-lem. 'No problem' is a friendly reply. 'Problem' + 'with', not 'in': 'a problem with the server'. Avoid 'I am facing a problem' every time — say 'I have a problem'.

examples.en: There is a problem with my laptop.
examples.hi: मेरे लैपटॉप में एक समस्या है।

examples.en: No problem, I can wait.
examples.hi: कोई बात नहीं, मैं इंतज़ार कर सकता हूँ।

examples.en: We solved the problem quickly.
examples.hi: हमने समस्या जल्दी हल कर ली।

examples.en: What's the problem?
examples.hi: क्या समस्या है?

examples.en: Money is not the problem.
examples.hi: पैसा समस्या नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a problem in my account.
common_mistake.right: I have a problem with my account.
common_mistake.why: 'Problem' takes 'with', not 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Is there a ____ with the payment?

en_def: the part of the body at the end of the arm
hi_nuance: 'By hand' = manually. 'Give me a hand' = help me. 'On the one hand… on the other hand' is for contrast. Vowel /æ/ as in 'bad'.

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.hi: खाने से पहले हाथ धोओ।

examples.en: She held the baby in her hands.
examples.hi: उसने बच्चे को अपने हाथों में पकड़ा।

examples.en: Can you give me a hand with this box?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस डिब्बे में मेरी मदद कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Raise your hand if you have a question.
examples.hi: अगर आपके पास सवाल है तो हाथ उठाएँ।

examples.en: This shirt was made by hand.
examples.hi: यह शर्ट हाथ से बनाई गई थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do a hand shake with him.
common_mistake.right: Please shake hands with him.
common_mistake.why: 'Shake hands' is the verb phrase; 'do a hand shake' is not English.

cloze.sentence: He waved his ____ to say goodbye.

en_def: a piece or section of something
hi_nuance: 'Part of' without an article: 'part of the problem', not 'a part of the problem' (both possible, but 'part of' is more natural). 'Take part in' = participate.

examples.en: This is the best part of the film.
examples.hi: यह फ़िल्म का सबसे अच्छा हिस्सा है।

examples.en: Which part of India are you from?
examples.hi: आप भारत के किस हिस्से से हैं?

examples.en: I only read part of the book.
examples.hi: मैंने किताब का केवल एक हिस्सा पढ़ा।

examples.en: She took part in the competition.
examples.hi: उसने प्रतियोगिता में भाग लिया।

examples.en: The car needs a new part.
examples.hi: गाड़ी को एक नए पुर्ज़े की ज़रूरत है।

common_mistake.wrong: I participated in the competition and took a part.
common_mistake.right: I took part in the competition.
common_mistake.why: 'Take part in' means participate; you don't need both, and 'a part' changes the meaning.

cloze.sentence: The first ____ of the exam was easy.

en_def: a particular area, town, building, or position
hi_nuance: 'My place' = my home. 'Take place' = happen. Hindi speakers say 'native place' — natural English is 'hometown'. 'In place of' = instead of.

examples.en: This is a nice place for a picnic.
examples.hi: यह पिकनिक के लिए अच्छी जगह है।

examples.en: Come to my place for dinner.
examples.hi: रात के खाने पर मेरे घर आओ।

examples.en: The meeting will take place on Monday.
examples.hi: बैठक सोमवार को होगी।

examples.en: Put everything back in its place.
examples.hi: हर चीज़ को उसकी जगह पर वापस रखो।

examples.en: Is there a place to park here?
examples.hi: क्या यहाँ गाड़ी खड़ी करने की जगह है?

common_mistake.wrong: I am going to my native place for Diwali.
common_mistake.right: I am going to my hometown for Diwali.
common_mistake.why: 'Native place' is Indian English; 'hometown' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Is there a quiet ____ where we can talk?

en_def: a particular situation or example; a container; a legal matter
hi_nuance: 'In case' = to be safe: 'Take a jacket in case it rains'. 'In that case' = if that is true. 'In case of' + noun: 'in case of fire'. Don't say 'in case if'.

examples.en: In that case, let's leave now.
examples.hi: उस स्थिति में, चलो अभी चलते हैं।

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.hi: बारिश हो जाए तो छाता ले लो।

examples.en: This is a clear case of phishing.
examples.hi: यह फ़िशिंग का साफ़ मामला है।

examples.en: Put your glasses in the case.
examples.hi: अपना चश्मा डिब्बे में रखो।

examples.en: The police are working on the case.
examples.hi: पुलिस इस मामले पर काम कर रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: In case if you need help, call me.
common_mistake.right: If you need help, call me.
common_mistake.why: 'In case' and 'if' are not used together.

cloze.sentence: Keep the receipt in ____ you want to return it.

en_def: a period of seven days
hi_nuance: Sounds the same as 'weak'. 'Next week', 'last week' — no 'in' or 'on'. 'Weekdays' = Monday to Friday; 'weekend' = Saturday and Sunday. 'A week' vs 'one week' — 'a week' is more natural.

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
examples.hi: मैं हफ़्ते में तीन बार जिम जाता हूँ।

examples.en: See you next week.
examples.hi: अगले हफ़्ते मिलते हैं।

examples.en: The report is due in two weeks.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट दो हफ़्ते में देनी है।

examples.en: She was ill all week.
examples.hi: वह पूरे हफ़्ते बीमार थी।

examples.en: Last week was very busy.
examples.hi: पिछला हफ़्ता बहुत व्यस्त था।

common_mistake.wrong: I will be on leave in next week.
common_mistake.right: I will be on leave next week.
common_mistake.why: 'Next week' takes no preposition.

cloze.sentence: How many days are there in a ____?

en_def: a business organisation; being with other people
hi_nuance: 'Work at/for a company', not 'work in a company'. 'Keep someone company' = stay with them. Vowel /ʌ/, stress on the first syllable.

examples.en: I work for a software company.
examples.hi: मैं एक सॉफ़्टवेयर कंपनी में काम करता हूँ।

examples.en: The company has two thousand employees.
examples.hi: कंपनी में दो हज़ार कर्मचारी हैं।

examples.en: She started her own company.
examples.hi: उसने अपनी खुद की कंपनी शुरू की।

examples.en: Thanks for keeping me company.
examples.hi: मेरा साथ देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Which company makes this phone?
examples.hi: यह फ़ोन कौन सी कंपनी बनाती है?

common_mistake.wrong: I am working in Wipro company.
common_mistake.right: I work at Wipro.
common_mistake.why: Use 'at' or 'for' with a company name, and don't add the word 'company' after the name.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ do you work for?

en_def: a set of connected things or rules that work together
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'system' to mean a computer ('my system is slow'); in international English say 'my computer' or 'my machine'. No vowel before 's'.

examples.en: The new booking system is easy to use.
examples.hi: नई बुकिंग प्रणाली इस्तेमाल करने में आसान है।

examples.en: The metro system covers the whole city.
examples.hi: मेट्रो प्रणाली पूरे शहर को कवर करती है।

examples.en: We need a better system for tracking bugs.
examples.hi: हमें बग ट्रैक करने के लिए बेहतर प्रणाली चाहिए।

examples.en: The system crashed during the update.
examples.hi: अपडेट के दौरान सिस्टम क्रैश हो गया।

examples.en: Every school has its own grading system.
examples.hi: हर स्कूल की अपनी ग्रेडिंग प्रणाली होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: My system is not starting today.
common_mistake.right: My computer won't start today.
common_mistake.why: 'System' for a personal computer is Indian English; say 'computer' or 'laptop'.

cloze.sentence: The ticket ____ was down for an hour.

en_def: a sentence that asks for information
hi_nuance: Pronounce /ˈkwestʃən/ — the 'qu' is /kw/ and the ending is /tʃən/, not 'kwes-tee-on'. You 'ask' a question, not 'put' or 'say' a question. Use 'question' not 'doubt' for something you want explained.

examples.en: She raised her hand to ask a question.
examples.hi: उसने सवाल पूछने के लिए हाथ उठाया।

examples.en: That's a good question.
examples.hi: यह एक अच्छा सवाल है।

examples.en: Answer all the questions on the page.
examples.hi: पृष्ठ के सभी सवालों के जवाब दो।

examples.en: There is no question of giving up.
examples.hi: हार मानने का कोई सवाल ही नहीं है।

examples.en: She had a question about the invoice.
examples.hi: उसे इनवॉइस के बारे में एक सवाल था।

common_mistake.wrong: I have one doubt about the deployment.
common_mistake.right: I have a question about the deployment.
common_mistake.why: 'Doubt' means disbelief; for something unclear, use 'question'.

cloze.sentence: Does anyone have a ____ before we finish?

en_def: regular paid work; a task
hi_nuance: 'Job' is countable ('a job'); 'work' is uncountable. 'Get a job', 'lose a job', 'apply for a job'. Starts with /dʒ/ like 'ज', ends in a clear /b/.

examples.en: I got a new job in Pune.
examples.hi: मुझे पुणे में नई नौकरी मिली।

examples.en: She is looking for a job.
examples.hi: वह नौकरी ढूँढ रही है।

examples.en: Good job! You did it well.
examples.hi: शाबाश! तुमने अच्छा किया।

examples.en: It's my job to check the logs.
examples.hi: लॉग जाँचना मेरा काम है।

examples.en: He lost his job during the recession.
examples.hi: मंदी के दौरान उसकी नौकरी चली गई।

common_mistake.wrong: I am searching a job.
common_mistake.right: I am looking for a job.
common_mistake.why: 'Search for' or 'look for' needs the preposition.

cloze.sentence: What is your ____ at the company?

en_def: a figure such as 1, 2, 3; a quantity
hi_nuance: 'A number of' = several (takes plural verb); 'the number of' = the total (takes singular verb). 'Phone number', 'room number' — 'number' comes after the noun.

examples.en: What is your phone number?
examples.hi: आपका फ़ोन नंबर क्या है?

examples.en: Pick a number between one and ten.
examples.hi: एक से दस के बीच एक संख्या चुनो।

examples.en: A number of people complained.
examples.hi: कई लोगों ने शिकायत की।

examples.en: The number of users is growing.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं की संख्या बढ़ रही है।

examples.en: My room number is 204.
examples.hi: मेरे कमरे का नंबर 204 है।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me your number phone.
common_mistake.right: Give me your phone number.
common_mistake.why: In English, the describing noun comes first: 'phone number'.

cloze.sentence: Please write your ID ____ at the top.

en_def: the time when it is dark and most people sleep
hi_nuance: 'At night' (no article) for nights in general; 'in the night' for a specific night. 'Good night' is only for leaving or sleeping — not a greeting. 'Last night', not 'yesterday night'.

examples.en: I couldn't sleep last night.
examples.hi: मुझे कल रात नींद नहीं आई।

examples.en: The shop is open at night.
examples.hi: दुकान रात में खुली रहती है।

examples.en: Good night; see you tomorrow.
examples.hi: शुभ रात्रि; कल मिलते हैं।

examples.en: We stayed two nights in Jaipur.
examples.hi: हम जयपुर में दो रातें रुके।

examples.en: It gets cold at night here.
examples.hi: यहाँ रात में ठंड हो जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I watched a film yesterday night.
common_mistake.right: I watched a film last night.
common_mistake.why: English says 'last night', not 'yesterday night'.

cloze.sentence: The baby cried all ____.

en_def: an idea or opinion; a particular moment or place; a unit of score
hi_nuance: 'What's the point?' = why bother. 'Good point' = I agree. 'Point of view' = opinion. 'Point out' = show. Diphthong /ɔɪ/ as in 'boy'.

examples.en: That's a good point.
examples.hi: यह एक अच्छी बात है।

examples.en: What's the point of waiting?
examples.hi: इंतज़ार करने का क्या फ़ायदा?

examples.en: We scored ten points.
examples.hi: हमने दस अंक बनाए।

examples.en: At this point, we should stop.
examples.hi: इस मोड़ पर हमें रुक जाना चाहिए।

examples.en: From my point of view, it's a mistake.
examples.hi: मेरे नज़रिए से, यह एक गलती है।

common_mistake.wrong: According to my point of view, we should wait.
common_mistake.right: In my opinion, we should wait.
common_mistake.why: 'According to' is for other people's views, never your own.

cloze.sentence: I see your ____, but I don't agree.

en_def: the place where you live
hi_nuance: 'Go home', 'come home', 'get home' — no 'to'. 'At home' = in the house. 'House' is the building; 'home' is where you live. Diphthong /əʊ/, not 'hom'.

examples.en: I'm going home now.
examples.hi: मैं अब घर जा रहा हूँ।

examples.en: She works from home on Fridays.
examples.hi: वह शुक्रवार को घर से काम करती है।

examples.en: Is anyone at home?
examples.hi: क्या घर पर कोई है?

examples.en: We got home late.
examples.hi: हम देर से घर पहुँचे।

examples.en: Make yourself at home.
examples.hi: आराम से रहिए, इसे अपना घर समझिए।

common_mistake.wrong: I will go to home after the meeting.
common_mistake.right: I will go home after the meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'Home' takes no 'to' after verbs of movement.

cloze.sentence: What time do you usually get ____?

en_def: the clear liquid that we drink and that falls as rain
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'some water', 'a glass of water' — never 'a water' or 'waters' (except in poetry). The 't' is a soft flap in American English, but the vowel /ɔː/ is long.

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water?
examples.hi: क्या मुझे एक गिलास पानी मिल सकता है?

examples.en: Drink plenty of water in summer.
examples.hi: गर्मियों में खूब पानी पियो।

examples.en: There is no hot water this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह गरम पानी नहीं है।

examples.en: The water in this lake is very clean.
examples.hi: इस झील का पानी बहुत साफ़ है।

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants.
examples.hi: पौधों को पानी देना मत भूलना।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me one water.
common_mistake.right: Please give me a glass of water.
common_mistake.why: 'Water' is uncountable; use a container word to count it.

cloze.sentence: Boil the ____ before you drink it.

en_def: a part of a building with walls and a door; space
hi_nuance: 'Room' meaning 'space' is uncountable: 'There is no room in the car'. 'Living room', 'bedroom', 'bathroom' — Hindi speakers say 'hall' for living room; that's Indian English.

examples.en: My room is on the second floor.
examples.hi: मेरा कमरा दूसरी मंज़िल पर है।

examples.en: Is there room for one more?
examples.hi: क्या एक और के लिए जगह है?

examples.en: We booked a room with a sea view.
examples.hi: हमने समुद्र के नज़ारे वाला कमरा बुक किया।

examples.en: The children are in the living room.
examples.hi: बच्चे बैठक में हैं।

examples.en: This room is too small for the meeting.
examples.hi: यह कमरा मीटिंग के लिए बहुत छोटा है।

common_mistake.wrong: The guests are sitting in the hall.
common_mistake.right: The guests are sitting in the living room.
common_mistake.why: 'Hall' in English is a corridor or a large public room, not the living room.

cloze.sentence: There is no ____ for another chair here.

en_def: a female parent
hi_nuance: The 'th' is the voiced /ð/ — tongue between the teeth with voice — not Hindi 'द' or 'ध'. 'Mum' (British) / 'Mom' (American) is informal. Say 'my mother', not 'my mummy' as an adult.

examples.en: My mother is a teacher.
examples.hi: मेरी माँ एक शिक्षिका हैं।

examples.en: She looks like her mother.
examples.hi: वह अपनी माँ जैसी दिखती है।

examples.en: Happy Mother's Day!
examples.hi: मातृ दिवस की शुभकामनाएँ!

examples.en: His mother called this morning.
examples.hi: उसकी माँ ने आज सुबह फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: I live with my mother and father.
examples.hi: मैं अपनी माँ और पिता के साथ रहता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: My mummy is a doctor.
common_mistake.right: My mother is a doctor.
common_mistake.why: 'Mummy' is baby talk; adults say 'mother' or 'mum'.

cloze.sentence: Her ____ cooks the best biryani.

en_def: a part of a place, town, or country; a subject or field
hi_nuance: Three syllables: AIR-ee-uh — not 'aria' or 'eria'. 'In this area' = in this neighbourhood. 'Area of expertise' = special skill. Not the same as 'locality', which is old-fashioned.

examples.en: I live in a quiet area.
examples.hi: मैं एक शांत इलाके में रहता हूँ।

examples.en: This area is famous for its temples.
examples.hi: यह इलाका अपने मंदिरों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

examples.en: Is there a hospital in this area?
examples.hi: क्या इस इलाके में कोई अस्पताल है?

examples.en: Security is my area of work.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा मेरा कार्यक्षेत्र है।

examples.en: The parking area is behind the building.
examples.hi: पार्किंग क्षेत्र इमारत के पीछे है।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many shops in my locality.
common_mistake.right: There are many shops in my area.
common_mistake.why: 'Locality' is rare in modern English; 'area' or 'neighbourhood' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ of the city do you live in?

en_def: coins and notes used to buy things
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'much money', 'a lot of money' — never 'monies' or 'many money'. Vowel /ʌ/ as in 'cup'. 'Rupees' is the countable unit.

examples.en: I don't have much money right now.
examples.hi: अभी मेरे पास ज़्यादा पैसे नहीं हैं।

examples.en: She earns good money.
examples.hi: वह अच्छे पैसे कमाती है।

examples.en: How much money do you need?
examples.hi: आपको कितने पैसे चाहिए?

examples.en: We are saving money for a house.
examples.hi: हम घर के लिए पैसे बचा रहे हैं।

examples.en: Time is money.
examples.hi: समय ही धन है।

common_mistake.wrong: How many money did you spend?
common_mistake.right: How much money did you spend?
common_mistake.why: 'Money' is uncountable, so it takes 'much', not 'many'.

cloze.sentence: He lent me some ____ for the ticket.

en_def: a description of events, real or imagined
hi_nuance: 'Tell a story', not 'say a story'. Plural 'stories'. 'Storey' (British) means a floor of a building — different word. No vowel before 'st'.

examples.en: My grandmother told us a story every night.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी हमें हर रात एक कहानी सुनाती थीं।

examples.en: It's a long story.
examples.hi: यह एक लंबी कहानी है।

examples.en: The news story was about the floods.
examples.hi: समाचार की कहानी बाढ़ के बारे में थी।

examples.en: Children love stories about animals.
examples.hi: बच्चों को जानवरों की कहानियाँ पसंद हैं।

examples.en: What's the story behind this photo?
examples.hi: इस फ़ोटो के पीछे क्या कहानी है?

common_mistake.wrong: She said us a nice story.
common_mistake.right: She told us a nice story.
common_mistake.why: Stories are 'told', and 'tell' takes the listener directly.

cloze.sentence: Read me a ____ before bed.

en_def: something that is known to be true
hi_nuance: 'In fact' = actually. 'The fact that' introduces a clause: 'the fact that he left'. Pronounce the final /kt/ clearly: /fækt/, not 'fak'.

examples.en: It's a fact that the earth is round.
examples.hi: यह एक तथ्य है कि पृथ्वी गोल है।

examples.en: In fact, I have never been there.
examples.hi: वास्तव में, मैं कभी वहाँ नहीं गया।

examples.en: Check the facts before you post.
examples.hi: पोस्ट करने से पहले तथ्य जाँच लो।

examples.en: The fact is, we need more time.
examples.hi: सच यह है कि हमें और समय चाहिए।

examples.en: She gave me some facts about the company.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे कंपनी के बारे में कुछ तथ्य बताए।

common_mistake.wrong: Actually fact is that he was absent.
common_mistake.right: The fact is that he was absent.
common_mistake.why: 'Fact' needs 'the', and 'actually' is not needed with it.

cloze.sentence: Is that a ____ or just your opinion?

en_def: one of the twelve periods of the year
hi_nuance: Ends with the soft 'th' /θ/ — not 'mont' or 'munth' with Hindi 'थ'. Plural 'months' /mʌnθs/ is hard for many learners; practise it. 'Next month' takes no preposition.

examples.en: I get paid at the end of the month.
examples.hi: मुझे महीने के अंत में वेतन मिलता है।

examples.en: She is leaving next month.
examples.hi: वह अगले महीने जा रही है।

examples.en: The project took six months.
examples.hi: प्रोजेक्ट में छह महीने लगे।

examples.en: Which month were you born in?
examples.hi: आप किस महीने में पैदा हुए थे?

examples.en: Rent is due on the first of every month.
examples.hi: किराया हर महीने की पहली तारीख़ को देना होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I joined the company before two months.
common_mistake.right: I joined the company two months ago.
common_mistake.why: For past time, use 'ago' after the period, not 'before' in front of it.

cloze.sentence: December is the last ____ of the year.

en_def: a large amount or number (a lot of / lots of)
hi_nuance: 'A lot of' works with both countable and uncountable nouns — safer than 'much/many' in positive sentences. 'A lot' (adverb) = very much: 'Thanks a lot'. Always two words: 'a lot', not 'alot'.

examples.en: There were a lot of people at the fair.
examples.hi: मेले में बहुत सारे लोग थे।

examples.en: I have a lot of work today.
examples.hi: मुझे आज बहुत काम है।

examples.en: Thanks a lot for your help.
examples.hi: आपकी मदद के लिए बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद।

examples.en: She travels a lot.
examples.hi: वह बहुत यात्रा करती है।

examples.en: We learnt a lot in the workshop.
examples.hi: हमने कार्यशाला में बहुत कुछ सीखा।

common_mistake.wrong: I have alot of friends.
common_mistake.right: I have a lot of friends.
common_mistake.why: 'A lot' is always two words.

cloze.sentence: He knows a ____ about networks.

en_def: correct; the opposite of left; morally good
hi_nuance: Same sound as 'write'. 'You are right' — not 'you are correct' every time. 'Right?' at the end of a sentence asks for agreement. 'Right now' = immediately.

examples.en: You are right; it was my mistake.
examples.hi: आप सही हैं; यह मेरी गलती थी।

examples.en: Turn right at the temple.
examples.hi: मंदिर पर दाहिने मुड़ो।

examples.en: Is this the right bus for the airport?
examples.hi: क्या यह हवाई अड्डे के लिए सही बस है?

examples.en: I'll do it right now.
examples.hi: मैं इसे अभी करता हूँ।

examples.en: It's not right to lie.
examples.hi: झूठ बोलना सही नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: You are telling right.
common_mistake.right: You are right.
common_mistake.why: 'Telling right' is a direct translation of Hindi; English uses 'be right'.

cloze.sentence: That's the ____ answer. Well done!

en_def: to spend time learning about a subject
hi_nuance: 'Study' takes no preposition before the subject: 'study English', not 'study about English'. Past 'studied'. 'Studies' as a noun = your education: 'How are your studies going?'.

examples.en: I study English for an hour every day.
examples.hi: मैं रोज़ एक घंटा अंग्रेज़ी पढ़ता हूँ।

examples.en: She studied medicine in Delhi.
examples.hi: उसने दिल्ली में मेडिसिन की पढ़ाई की।

examples.en: You need to study harder for the exam.
examples.hi: तुम्हें परीक्षा के लिए और मेहनत से पढ़ना होगा।

examples.en: He is studying for a security certification.
examples.hi: वह एक सुरक्षा प्रमाणपत्र की तैयारी कर रहा है।

examples.en: We studied the report carefully.
examples.hi: हमने रिपोर्ट का ध्यान से अध्ययन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am studying about networking.
common_mistake.right: I am studying networking.
common_mistake.why: 'Study' takes the subject directly, without 'about'.

cloze.sentence: Where did you ____ computer science?

en_def: printed pages joined together with a cover; (verb) to reserve
hi_nuance: Short /ʊ/ vowel, same as 'put'. As a verb, 'book a ticket/table/room' — Indian English 'do the booking' is clumsy. 'Booked' = reserved.

examples.en: I am reading a book about history.
examples.hi: मैं इतिहास के बारे में एक किताब पढ़ रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Can you book a table for four?
examples.hi: क्या आप चार लोगों के लिए मेज़ बुक कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: She has written two books.
examples.hi: उसने दो किताबें लिखी हैं।

examples.en: I booked the flight online.
examples.hi: मैंने फ़्लाइट ऑनलाइन बुक की।

examples.en: Please return the book by Friday.
examples.hi: कृपया किताब शुक्रवार तक लौटा दें।

common_mistake.wrong: I will do the booking of the hotel.
common_mistake.right: I will book the hotel.
common_mistake.why: 'Book' is a verb; 'do the booking' is an unnatural Indianism.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ are you reading now?

en_def: the part of the body you see with
hi_nuance: Same sound as 'I'. 'Keep an eye on' = watch carefully. 'In my eyes' = in my opinion. Plural 'eyes' /aɪz/.

examples.en: She has brown eyes.
examples.hi: उसकी आँखें भूरी हैं।

examples.en: Close your eyes and relax.
examples.hi: अपनी आँखें बंद करो और आराम करो।

examples.en: Keep an eye on the children.
examples.hi: बच्चों पर नज़र रखना।

examples.en: My eyes hurt after working all day.
examples.hi: पूरे दिन काम करने के बाद मेरी आँखें दुखती हैं।

examples.en: He looked me in the eye.
examples.hi: उसने मेरी आँखों में देखा।

common_mistake.wrong: I have pain in my eyes since two days.
common_mistake.right: My eyes have hurt for two days.
common_mistake.why: Use 'hurt' as a verb and 'for' for a duration.

cloze.sentence: Make ____ contact when you speak.

en_def: a single unit of language with meaning
hi_nuance: Vowel /ɜː/ as in 'bird' — not 'ward' or 'vord'. Start with a rounded /w/, not /v/. 'Word for word' = exactly. 'Have a word with' = talk briefly.

examples.en: How do you pronounce this word?
examples.hi: इस शब्द का उच्चारण कैसे करते हैं?

examples.en: I learn five new words every day.
examples.hi: मैं रोज़ पाँच नए शब्द सीखता हूँ।

examples.en: Can I have a word with you?
examples.hi: क्या मैं आपसे एक बात कर सकता हूँ?

examples.en: She didn't say a word all evening.
examples.hi: उसने पूरी शाम एक शब्द नहीं कहा।

examples.en: Copy it word for word.
examples.hi: इसे शब्दशः नकल करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Tell me the meaning of this ward.
common_mistake.right: Tell me the meaning of this word.
common_mistake.why: 'Ward' /wɔːd/ is a hospital section; 'word' has the /ɜː/ vowel.

cloze.sentence: Say the ____ slowly and clearly.

en_def: buying and selling; a company; a matter
hi_nuance: Two syllables: BIZ-nis — the middle 'i' is silent. Uncountable for the activity ('business is good'), countable for a company ('a small business'). 'None of your business' = private.

examples.en: My uncle runs a small business.
examples.hi: मेरे चाचा एक छोटा व्यापार चलाते हैं।

examples.en: Business is slow this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने कारोबार धीमा है।

examples.en: She is in Mumbai on business.
examples.hi: वह काम के सिलसिले में मुंबई में है।

examples.en: It's none of your business.
examples.hi: यह आपका मामला नहीं है।

examples.en: They do business with many countries.
examples.hi: वे कई देशों के साथ व्यापार करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: He is doing a business of clothes.
common_mistake.right: He runs a clothing business.
common_mistake.why: Say what kind of business and use 'run' or 'have', not 'do a business of'.

cloze.sentence: He started his own ____ last year.

en_def: an important problem or topic; one edition of a magazine
hi_nuance: Pronounce /ˈɪʃuː/ (ISH-oo). Indian English overuses 'issue' for every problem — vary with 'problem' or 'trouble'. 'Have an issue with' = have a problem or disagreement.

examples.en: We have an issue with the login page.
examples.hi: लॉगिन पेज में हमें एक समस्या है।

examples.en: Climate change is a global issue.
examples.hi: जलवायु परिवर्तन एक वैश्विक मुद्दा है।

examples.en: Please raise the issue in the meeting.
examples.hi: कृपया मीटिंग में यह मुद्दा उठाएँ।

examples.en: The latest issue of the magazine is out.
examples.hi: पत्रिका का नया अंक आ गया है।

examples.en: Is there any issue with the payment?
examples.hi: क्या भुगतान में कोई समस्या है?

common_mistake.wrong: I am facing one issue in the login.
common_mistake.right: I have an issue with the login.
common_mistake.why: Use the article 'an' and the preposition 'with'; 'one' is not an article.

cloze.sentence: Let's discuss this ____ tomorrow.

en_def: a surface or edge of something; one of two positions in an argument
hi_nuance: 'On the left side', 'by my side', 'side by side'. Hindi speakers say 'this side / that side' where English needs 'over here / over there'. 'Side effects' = unwanted results.

examples.en: Sit on this side of the table.
examples.hi: मेज़ की इस तरफ़ बैठो।

examples.en: The shop is on the other side of the road.
examples.hi: दुकान सड़क के दूसरी तरफ़ है।

examples.en: Whose side are you on?
examples.hi: आप किसकी तरफ़ हैं?

examples.en: Write your name on the back side.
examples.hi: पीछे की तरफ़ अपना नाम लिखो।

examples.en: They walked side by side.
examples.hi: वे साथ-साथ चले।

common_mistake.wrong: Come this side, please.
common_mistake.right: Come over here, please.
common_mistake.why: 'This side' for direction is Hindi-influenced; use 'over here'.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ of the bed do you sleep on?

en_def: a type or sort; (adjective) caring and friendly
hi_nuance: 'What kind of' = which type. 'Kind of' (informal) = somewhat: 'It's kind of cold'. As an adjective, 'kind' = nice. 'Kindly' is overused in Indian emails — just say 'please'.

examples.en: What kind of music do you like?
examples.hi: आपको किस तरह का संगीत पसंद है?

examples.en: She is a very kind person.
examples.hi: वह बहुत दयालु इंसान है।

examples.en: This is a different kind of problem.
examples.hi: यह एक अलग तरह की समस्या है।

examples.en: It was kind of you to help.
examples.hi: मदद करके आपने बड़ी दया दिखाई।

examples.en: I'm kind of tired today.
examples.hi: मैं आज थोड़ा थका हुआ हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly revert with the details.
common_mistake.right: Please reply with the details.
common_mistake.why: 'Kindly' and 'revert' are Indianisms; 'please reply' is natural.

cloze.sentence: What ____ of phone do you have?

en_def: the top part of the body with the brain, eyes, and mouth; the leader; the top
hi_nuance: Short /e/ vowel, like 'bed' — not 'heed'. 'Head of department' = leader. 'Headache' is one word. 'Head' can be a verb: 'head home' = go home.

examples.en: I have a headache.
examples.hi: मेरे सिर में दर्द है।

examples.en: She nodded her head.
examples.hi: उसने सिर हिलाया।

examples.en: He is the head of the security team.
examples.hi: वह सुरक्षा टीम का प्रमुख है।

examples.en: Mind your head; the door is low.
examples.hi: सिर संभालना; दरवाज़ा नीचा है।

examples.en: Let's head home; it's late.
examples.hi: चलो घर चलते हैं; देर हो गई है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have pain in head.
common_mistake.right: I have a headache.
common_mistake.why: English uses the single noun 'headache' with the article 'a'.

cloze.sentence: He hit his ____ on the shelf.

en_def: a building where people live
hi_nuance: Noun /haʊs/ ends in /s/; the verb 'to house' ends in /z/. Plural 'houses' /ˈhaʊzɪz/. 'House' = the building; 'home' = where you live. 'At my house' vs 'at home'.

examples.en: They bought a house near the lake.
examples.hi: उन्होंने झील के पास एक मकान खरीदा।

examples.en: Our house has three bedrooms.
examples.hi: हमारे घर में तीन शयनकक्ष हैं।

examples.en: Come to my house on Sunday.
examples.hi: रविवार को मेरे घर आना।

examples.en: The houses on this street are old.
examples.hi: इस गली के मकान पुराने हैं।

examples.en: She cleaned the whole house.
examples.hi: उसने पूरा घर साफ़ किया।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many big houses in my area — I mean 'housez'.
common_mistake.right: There are many big houses in my area — pronounced 'how-ziz'.
common_mistake.why: The plural 'houses' is pronounced /ˈhaʊzɪz/ with a /z/ sound.

cloze.sentence: Whose ____ is that with the red door?

en_def: work done for customers; a system provided to the public
hi_nuance: 'Service' is uncountable for the quality of help ('the service was slow') and countable for a system ('bus services'). Indian English 'get the car serviced' is correct. 'Service' with /v/, not /w/.

examples.en: The service at this hotel is excellent.
examples.hi: इस होटल की सेवा बहुत अच्छी है।

examples.en: Bus services stop at midnight.
examples.hi: बस सेवाएँ आधी रात को बंद हो जाती हैं।

examples.en: I need to get my car serviced.
examples.hi: मुझे अपनी गाड़ी की सर्विस करानी है।

examples.en: Customer service is closed on Sundays.
examples.hi: ग्राहक सेवा रविवार को बंद रहती है।

examples.en: Is there mobile service in the hills?
examples.hi: क्या पहाड़ों में मोबाइल सेवा है?

common_mistake.wrong: There is no services in this village.
common_mistake.right: There are no services in this village.
common_mistake.why: 'Services' is plural, so the verb must be 'are'.

cloze.sentence: The restaurant is known for its fast ____.

en_def: a person you know well and like
hi_nuance: The 'i' is silent: /frend/. 'Make friends', not 'make friendship'. 'A friend of mine', not 'my one friend'. 'Friend' is not a verb in speech (only on social media).

examples.en: She is my best friend.
examples.hi: वह मेरी सबसे अच्छी दोस्त है।

examples.en: I made some new friends at work.
examples.hi: मैंने काम पर कुछ नए दोस्त बनाए।

examples.en: A friend of mine lives in London.
examples.hi: मेरा एक दोस्त लंदन में रहता है।

examples.en: We have been friends since school.
examples.hi: हम स्कूल के समय से दोस्त हैं।

examples.en: He is a good friend to everyone.
examples.hi: वह सबका अच्छा दोस्त है।

common_mistake.wrong: My one friend is coming from Surat.
common_mistake.right: A friend of mine is coming from Surat.
common_mistake.why: 'My one friend' is Hindi word order; English uses 'a friend of mine'.

cloze.sentence: I'm meeting an old ____ for lunch.

en_def: a male parent
hi_nuance: 'th' here is voiced /ð/. Long /ɑː/ in the first syllable. 'Dad' is informal. 'Father-in-law' for your wife's father — not 'father in law' without hyphens.

examples.en: My father is a farmer.
examples.hi: मेरे पिता एक किसान हैं।

examples.en: He became a father last year.
examples.hi: वह पिछले साल पिता बना।

examples.en: Her father works in Dubai.
examples.hi: उसके पिता दुबई में काम करते हैं।

examples.en: I look like my father.
examples.hi: मैं अपने पिता जैसा दिखता हूँ।

examples.en: Father's Day is in June.
examples.hi: पितृ दिवस जून में होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My father he is a doctor.
common_mistake.right: My father is a doctor.
common_mistake.why: Do not repeat the subject with a pronoun.

cloze.sentence: His ____ taught him to fix cars.

en_def: the ability to control or influence; electricity; strength
hi_nuance: Indian English 'power cut' and 'the power is gone' are correct in British English too. 'Power' for electricity is uncountable. 'In power' = governing.

examples.en: There was a power cut last night.
examples.hi: कल रात बिजली गुल थी।

examples.en: The manager has the power to decide.
examples.hi: मैनेजर के पास फ़ैसला लेने की शक्ति है।

examples.en: Solar power is getting cheaper.
examples.hi: सौर ऊर्जा सस्ती हो रही है।

examples.en: Knowledge is power.
examples.hi: ज्ञान ही शक्ति है।

examples.en: Please turn off the power before you open it.
examples.hi: इसे खोलने से पहले बिजली बंद कर दो।

common_mistake.wrong: Current is gone in my area.
common_mistake.right: The power is out in my area.
common_mistake.why: 'Current' for electricity is Indian English; say 'power'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ went off during the storm.

en_def: a period of sixty minutes
hi_nuance: The 'h' is silent, so it takes 'an': 'an hour'. Same sound as 'our'. 'Half an hour', not 'half hour'. 'Office hours' = working time.

examples.en: The meeting lasted an hour.
examples.hi: बैठक एक घंटे तक चली।

examples.en: I'll be there in half an hour.
examples.hi: मैं आधे घंटे में वहाँ पहुँच जाऊँगा।

examples.en: She works ten hours a day.
examples.hi: वह दिन में दस घंटे काम करती है।

examples.en: The shop is open twenty-four hours.
examples.hi: दुकान चौबीस घंटे खुली रहती है।

examples.en: We waited for two hours.
examples.hi: हमने दो घंटे इंतज़ार किया।

common_mistake.wrong: It took a hour to reach.
common_mistake.right: It took an hour to get there.
common_mistake.why: 'Hour' starts with a vowel sound because the 'h' is silent.

cloze.sentence: The train leaves in an ____.

en_def: an activity with rules that people play for fun or in competition
hi_nuance: 'Play a game', 'win/lose a game'. A 'match' is a competitive game between teams — 'cricket match', but 'video game'. Diphthong /eɪ/ as in 'name'.

examples.en: Let's play a game.
examples.hi: चलो एक खेल खेलते हैं।

examples.en: My son loves video games.
examples.hi: मेरे बेटे को वीडियो गेम बहुत पसंद हैं।

examples.en: We lost the game by one point.
examples.hi: हम एक अंक से खेल हार गए।

examples.en: Chess is a game of skill.
examples.hi: शतरंज कौशल का खेल है।

examples.en: The game starts at seven.
examples.hi: खेल सात बजे शुरू होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I like to play games on mobile.
common_mistake.right: I like to play games on my phone.
common_mistake.why: 'Mobile' alone is Indian English; say 'phone' or 'mobile phone', with a possessive.

cloze.sentence: Which ____ did you play at school?

en_def: a long thin mark; a row of people; a phone connection
hi_nuance: 'Stand in line' (American) / 'queue' (British). 'The line is busy' for phones. 'Line' in Indian English also means a job field ('which line are you in?') — say 'field' instead.

examples.en: Draw a straight line.
examples.hi: एक सीधी रेखा खींचो।

examples.en: There was a long line at the counter.
examples.hi: काउंटर पर लंबी कतार थी।

examples.en: Hold the line, please.
examples.hi: कृपया लाइन पर बने रहिए।

examples.en: Read the first line aloud.
examples.hi: पहली पंक्ति ज़ोर से पढ़ो।

examples.en: The line is bad; I can't hear you.
examples.hi: लाइन खराब है; मुझे आपकी आवाज़ नहीं आ रही।

common_mistake.wrong: Which line are you in?
common_mistake.right: Which field do you work in?
common_mistake.why: 'Line' for a profession is Indian English; use 'field' or 'industry'.

cloze.sentence: Please wait in ____ for your turn.

en_def: the last part of something; the point where it stops; (verb) to finish
hi_nuance: 'At the end of' = the final part; 'in the end' = finally, after everything. 'End up' + -ing = finally be in a situation. 'The end' — not 'the last' — for stories.

examples.en: We'll meet at the end of the month.
examples.hi: हम महीने के अंत में मिलेंगे।

examples.en: In the end, we took the train.
examples.hi: अंत में, हमने ट्रेन ली।

examples.en: The film ends with a wedding.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म एक शादी के साथ ख़त्म होती है।

examples.en: Walk to the end of the street.
examples.hi: गली के आख़िर तक चलो।

examples.en: The meeting ended at five.
examples.hi: बैठक पाँच बजे ख़त्म हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: At the end, we decided to cancel.
common_mistake.right: In the end, we decided to cancel.
common_mistake.why: 'In the end' means finally; 'at the end' needs 'of' + something.

cloze.sentence: There is a small shop at the ____ of the road.

en_def: a person who belongs to a group, club, or organisation
hi_nuance: 'Member of' + group: 'a member of the team'. Indian English 'family members' is fine. 'Membership' is the state of being a member. Stress the first syllable.

examples.en: She is a member of the security team.
examples.hi: वह सुरक्षा टीम की सदस्य है।

examples.en: All members must show their cards.
examples.hi: सभी सदस्यों को अपना कार्ड दिखाना होगा।

examples.en: How many family members do you have?
examples.hi: आपके परिवार में कितने सदस्य हैं?

examples.en: I became a member of the library.
examples.hi: मैं पुस्तकालय का सदस्य बन गया।

examples.en: Two members were absent today.
examples.hi: आज दो सदस्य अनुपस्थित थे।

common_mistake.wrong: He is member in our club.
common_mistake.right: He is a member of our club.
common_mistake.why: 'Member' is countable and needs 'a', and it takes 'of', not 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Every ____ gets a discount.

en_def: a rule made by a government; the system of rules
hi_nuance: Long /ɔː/ vowel, same as 'saw' and 'door' — not 'law' with a short 'a'. 'Against the law' = illegal. 'Study law' (no article). 'A lawyer' is the person.

examples.en: Driving without a licence is against the law.
examples.hi: बिना लाइसेंस के गाड़ी चलाना कानून के ख़िलाफ़ है।

examples.en: She is studying law.
examples.hi: वह कानून की पढ़ाई कर रही है।

examples.en: The new law starts next month.
examples.hi: नया कानून अगले महीने से लागू होगा।

examples.en: Everyone must obey the law.
examples.hi: सभी को कानून का पालन करना चाहिए।

examples.en: There are strict laws about data privacy.
examples.hi: डेटा गोपनीयता के बारे में सख़्त कानून हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: It is a law breaking to park here.
common_mistake.right: It is against the law to park here.
common_mistake.why: 'Against the law' or 'illegal' is the natural phrase.

cloze.sentence: Wearing a helmet is required by ____.

en_def: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine
hi_nuance: 'By car' (no article) for the method; 'in the car' for location. Long /ɑː/ vowel; the 'r' is silent in British English. 'Vehicle' is formal.

examples.en: I go to work by car.
examples.hi: मैं कार से काम पर जाता हूँ।

examples.en: She parked the car outside.
examples.hi: उसने कार बाहर खड़ी की।

examples.en: We bought a second-hand car.
examples.hi: हमने एक पुरानी कार खरीदी।

examples.en: The car won't start in the cold.
examples.hi: ठंड में कार स्टार्ट नहीं होती।

examples.en: Get in the car; we're late.
examples.hi: कार में बैठो; हमें देर हो रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: I came here in car.
common_mistake.right: I came here by car.
common_mistake.why: Means of transport use 'by' with no article.

cloze.sentence: Is that your ____ outside?

en_def: a large and important town
hi_nuance: Plural 'cities'. 'In the city' = in the urban area; 'the city centre' (British) / 'downtown' (American). 'Town' is smaller than a city.

examples.en: Mumbai is a very big city.
examples.hi: मुंबई बहुत बड़ा शहर है।

examples.en: Which city do you live in?
examples.hi: आप किस शहर में रहते हैं?

examples.en: The city is crowded on weekends.
examples.hi: शहर सप्ताहांत में भीड़भाड़ वाला होता है।

examples.en: I prefer the city to the village.
examples.hi: मुझे गाँव की तुलना में शहर ज़्यादा पसंद है।

examples.en: Many cities have metro systems now.
examples.hi: अब कई शहरों में मेट्रो प्रणाली है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am from Ahmedabad city.
common_mistake.right: I am from Ahmedabad.
common_mistake.why: Don't add 'city' after the name of a well-known city.

cloze.sentence: Delhi is the capital ____ of India.

en_def: the word that a person or thing is called by
hi_nuance: 'My name is Balvant' — never 'Myself Balvant'. 'First name' and 'surname/last name'. 'What is your good name?' is an Indianism — just 'What is your name?'.

examples.en: My name is Balvant.
examples.hi: मेरा नाम बलवंत है।

examples.en: What is your name?
examples.hi: आपका नाम क्या है?

examples.en: Please write your full name here.
examples.hi: कृपया यहाँ अपना पूरा नाम लिखें।

examples.en: I forgot her name.
examples.hi: मैं उसका नाम भूल गया।

examples.en: They named the baby Aarav.
examples.hi: उन्होंने बच्चे का नाम आरव रखा।

common_mistake.wrong: What is your good name, sir?
common_mistake.right: What is your name?
common_mistake.why: 'Good name' is Indian English; English just says 'name'.

cloze.sentence: Could you spell your ____ for me?

en_def: of high quality; pleasant; kind; skilled
hi_nuance: Short /ʊ/ as in 'put'. 'Good at' + skill: 'good at maths', not 'good in maths'. Comparative is 'better', superlative 'best' — not 'gooder'. 'Well' is the adverb: 'She sings well'.

examples.en: This is a good restaurant.
examples.hi: यह एक अच्छा रेस्तराँ है।

examples.en: She is good at maths.
examples.hi: वह गणित में अच्छी है।

examples.en: Have a good day!
examples.hi: आपका दिन अच्छा हो!

examples.en: It's good to see you again.
examples.hi: आपको फिर से देखकर अच्छा लगा।

examples.en: He is a good father.
examples.hi: वह एक अच्छा पिता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am good in English.
common_mistake.right: I am good at English.
common_mistake.why: 'Good' takes 'at' for skills and subjects.

cloze.sentence: That's a ____ idea; let's do it.

en_def: recently made, bought, or started; not seen before
hi_nuance: British /njuː/ (with a 'y' sound), American /nuː/. 'New to' = unfamiliar with: 'I am new to this city'. 'Brand new' = completely new.

examples.en: I bought a new phone.
examples.hi: मैंने एक नया फ़ोन खरीदा।

examples.en: She is new to the team.
examples.hi: वह टीम में नई है।

examples.en: What's new with you?
examples.hi: आपके साथ क्या नया है?

examples.en: We moved to a new flat last week.
examples.hi: हम पिछले हफ़्ते एक नए फ़्लैट में गए।

examples.en: This is a brand new laptop.
examples.hi: यह एकदम नया लैपटॉप है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am new in this company.
common_mistake.right: I am new to this company.
common_mistake.why: 'New' takes 'to' for a place or job you have just joined.

cloze.sentence: Have you met the ____ manager?

en_def: coming before all others; number one
hi_nuance: Always 'the first', with the article. 'At first' = in the beginning (things changed later); 'first' or 'firstly' = the first point in a list. 'First time' — 'It's my first time here'.

examples.en: This is my first day at work.
examples.hi: यह मेरा काम पर पहला दिन है।

examples.en: She came first in the race.
examples.hi: वह दौड़ में पहले स्थान पर आई।

examples.en: At first, I didn't like the city.
examples.hi: शुरू में, मुझे शहर पसंद नहीं था।

examples.en: First, turn on the computer.
examples.hi: पहले, कंप्यूटर चालू करो।

examples.en: Who arrived first?
examples.hi: सबसे पहले कौन पहुँचा?

common_mistake.wrong: This is first time I am seeing snow.
common_mistake.right: This is the first time I have seen snow.
common_mistake.why: 'First' needs 'the', and 'the first time' takes the present perfect.

cloze.sentence: January is the ____ month of the year.

en_def: coming after all others; most recent; (verb) to continue for a time
hi_nuance: 'Last week/month/year' = the one before this — no 'the' and no 'in'. 'The last week' = the final week of something. As a verb: 'The meeting lasted two hours'.

examples.en: I saw him last week.
examples.hi: मैंने उसे पिछले हफ़्ते देखा था।

examples.en: This is the last bus tonight.
examples.hi: यह आज रात की आख़िरी बस है।

examples.en: The film lasts three hours.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म तीन घंटे चलती है।

examples.en: She was the last to leave.
examples.hi: वह जाने वाली आख़िरी थी।

examples.en: When did you last see a doctor?
examples.hi: आप आख़िरी बार डॉक्टर के पास कब गए थे?

common_mistake.wrong: I met her in last month.
common_mistake.right: I met her last month.
common_mistake.why: 'Last month' takes no preposition.

cloze.sentence: What did you do ____ weekend?

en_def: measuring a great distance or time
hi_nuance: 'How long' asks about time or length. 'A long time', not 'a long period of time' every time. 'Long' is for objects and time; for people's height use 'tall'. The final /ŋ/ has no /g/ sound after it.

examples.en: It's a long way to the airport.
examples.hi: हवाई अड्डा बहुत दूर है।

examples.en: How long is the flight?
examples.hi: उड़ान कितनी लंबी है?

examples.en: I haven't seen you for a long time.
examples.hi: मैंने आपको बहुत समय से नहीं देखा।

examples.en: She has long hair.
examples.hi: उसके बाल लंबे हैं।

examples.en: Don't be long; dinner is ready.
examples.hi: देर मत करना; खाना तैयार है।

common_mistake.wrong: My brother is very long.
common_mistake.right: My brother is very tall.
common_mistake.why: People are 'tall'; objects and distances are 'long'.

cloze.sentence: How ____ have you lived here?

en_def: very good; very large or important
hi_nuance: Pronounced /ɡreɪt/, rhymes with 'late' — not 'greet'. 'Great!' is a common enthusiastic reply. 'A great deal of' = a lot of (formal).

examples.en: That's a great idea!
examples.hi: यह बढ़िया विचार है!

examples.en: We had a great time in Kerala.
examples.hi: केरल में हमने बहुत अच्छा समय बिताया।

examples.en: She is a great cook.
examples.hi: वह बहुत अच्छा खाना बनाती है।

examples.en: Gandhi was a great leader.
examples.hi: गांधी एक महान नेता थे।

examples.en: It's great to see you.
examples.hi: आपको देखकर बहुत अच्छा लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: The food was too great.
common_mistake.right: The food was really great.
common_mistake.why: 'Too' means 'more than needed', which is negative; use 'really' or 'very'.

cloze.sentence: You did a ____ job on the report.

en_def: small in size; (a little) a small amount
hi_nuance: 'A little' (some, positive) vs 'little' (almost none, negative): 'I have a little time' = some; 'I have little time' = not enough. Used with uncountable nouns; 'a few' is for countable.

examples.en: She has a little daughter.
examples.hi: उसकी एक छोटी बेटी है।

examples.en: I speak a little Gujarati.
examples.hi: मैं थोड़ी गुजराती बोलता हूँ।

examples.en: There is little time left.
examples.hi: बहुत कम समय बचा है।

examples.en: Add a little salt.
examples.hi: थोड़ा नमक डालो।

examples.en: Wait a little; he is coming.
examples.hi: थोड़ा रुको; वह आ रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a little friends here.
common_mistake.right: I have a few friends here.
common_mistake.why: 'A little' is for uncountable nouns; 'friends' is countable, so use 'a few'.

cloze.sentence: Can I have a ____ more rice?

en_def: belonging to yourself and no one else; (verb) to have as property
hi_nuance: 'Own' always follows a possessive: 'my own car', never 'own car' or 'an own car'. 'On my own' = alone. As a verb: 'She owns two shops'.

examples.en: I have my own room now.
examples.hi: अब मेरा अपना कमरा है।

examples.en: He wants a place of his own.
examples.hi: वह अपनी खुद की जगह चाहता है।

examples.en: Do you own a car?
examples.hi: क्या आपके पास अपनी कार है?

examples.en: He lives on his own.
examples.hi: वह अकेला रहता है।

examples.en: Mind your own business.
examples.hi: अपने काम से काम रखो।

common_mistake.wrong: I have own laptop.
common_mistake.right: I have my own laptop.
common_mistake.why: 'Own' must follow a possessive word like 'my' or 'her'.

cloze.sentence: I want to start my ____ business one day.

en_def: different from the one already mentioned; additional
hi_nuance: Voiced /ð/ in the middle. 'The other' = the second of two; 'another' = one more; 'others' = other people/things. 'Each other' for two people.

examples.en: The other shoe is under the bed.
examples.hi: दूसरा जूता बिस्तर के नीचे है।

examples.en: Do you have any other questions?
examples.hi: क्या आपके कोई और सवाल हैं?

examples.en: Some people like tea; others like coffee.
examples.hi: कुछ लोगों को चाय पसंद है; दूसरों को कॉफ़ी।

examples.en: They help each other.
examples.hi: वे एक-दूसरे की मदद करते हैं।

examples.en: I bumped into her the other day at the market.
examples.hi: कुछ दिन पहले मैं बाज़ार में उससे टकरा गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Give me other cup of tea.
common_mistake.right: Give me another cup of tea.
common_mistake.why: 'Another' means 'one more'; 'other' needs 'the' or a plural.

cloze.sentence: Where is the ____ key?

en_def: having lived or existed for a long time; of a particular age
hi_nuance: 'Old' for both objects (पुराना) and people (बूढ़ा). Age: 'I am thirty years old' — 'years old' together, not 'thirty years'. Say 'How old are you?', not 'What is your age?'.

examples.en: My grandfather is ninety years old.
examples.hi: मेरे दादाजी नब्बे साल के हैं।

examples.en: This is an old building.
examples.hi: यह एक पुरानी इमारत है।

examples.en: How old is your daughter?
examples.hi: आपकी बेटी कितने साल की है?

examples.en: I met an old friend yesterday.
examples.hi: कल मैं एक पुराने दोस्त से मिला।

examples.en: These old shoes are still comfortable.
examples.hi: ये पुराने जूते अभी भी आरामदायक हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My age is 30 years.
common_mistake.right: I am 30 years old.
common_mistake.why: English states age with 'be' + number + 'years old'.

cloze.sentence: How ____ are you?

en_def: large in size or amount; important
hi_nuance: Comparative 'bigger', superlative 'biggest' — double the 'g'. 'Big' is informal; 'large' is more formal. 'My big brother' = older brother (informal). Don't say 'big problem' every time — 'serious problem' is better.

examples.en: They live in a big house.
examples.hi: वे एक बड़े घर में रहते हैं।

examples.en: Mumbai is bigger than Surat.
examples.hi: मुंबई सूरत से बड़ा है।

examples.en: It was a big mistake.
examples.hi: यह एक बड़ी गलती थी।

examples.en: This is the biggest project of my career.
examples.hi: यह मेरे करियर का सबसे बड़ा प्रोजेक्ट है।

examples.en: He has a big family.
examples.hi: उसका परिवार बड़ा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Delhi is more big than Jaipur.
common_mistake.right: Delhi is bigger than Jaipur.
common_mistake.why: Short adjectives form the comparative with '-er', not 'more'.

cloze.sentence: I need a ____ bag for this trip.

en_def: a great distance from bottom to top; large in amount or level
hi_nuance: The 'gh' is silent: /haɪ/. 'High' for mountains, prices, temperatures, and levels; 'tall' for people, trees, and buildings. 'High school' is an American term.

examples.en: The prices are very high here.
examples.hi: यहाँ कीमतें बहुत ऊँची हैं।

examples.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain.
examples.hi: माउंट एवरेस्ट सबसे ऊँचा पहाड़ है।

examples.en: She has a high fever.
examples.hi: उसे तेज़ बुखार है।

examples.en: The shelf is too high for me.
examples.hi: शेल्फ़ मेरे लिए बहुत ऊँची है।

examples.en: This job has a high salary.
examples.hi: इस नौकरी में वेतन ऊँचा है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very high man.
common_mistake.right: He is a very tall man.
common_mistake.why: People are 'tall'; 'high' describes position, level, or amount.

cloze.sentence: The temperature is very ____ today.

en_def: not the same
hi_nuance: Two syllables in fast speech: DIF-rent. 'Different from' (British and American), 'different to' (British) — but never 'different than' in formal writing. Stress on the first syllable.

examples.en: My brother and I are very different.
examples.hi: मैं और मेरा भाई बहुत अलग हैं।

examples.en: This phone is different from mine.
examples.hi: यह फ़ोन मेरे फ़ोन से अलग है।

examples.en: We visited three different cities.
examples.hi: हमने तीन अलग-अलग शहरों की यात्रा की।

examples.en: Let's try a different approach.
examples.hi: चलो एक अलग तरीका आज़माते हैं।

examples.en: Life in a village is very different.
examples.hi: गाँव की ज़िंदगी बहुत अलग होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Gujarati is very different with Hindi.
common_mistake.right: Gujarati is very different from Hindi.
common_mistake.why: 'Different' takes 'from', not 'with'.

cloze.sentence: Each student gave a ____ answer.

en_def: little in size or amount
hi_nuance: No vowel before 'sm'. Long /ɔː/ vowel like 'call'. 'Small' is neutral; 'little' adds feeling ('a little baby'). 'Small talk' = light conversation.

examples.en: We live in a small town.
examples.hi: हम एक छोटे कस्बे में रहते हैं।

examples.en: Can I have a small coffee?
examples.hi: क्या मुझे एक छोटी कॉफ़ी मिल सकती है?

examples.en: It's only a small problem.
examples.hi: यह सिर्फ़ एक छोटी समस्या है।

examples.en: The room is too small for ten people.
examples.hi: कमरा दस लोगों के लिए बहुत छोटा है।

examples.en: She runs a small business.
examples.hi: वह एक छोटा व्यवसाय चलाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: My village is very small and less developed.
common_mistake.right: My village is very small and not very developed.
common_mistake.why: 'Less developed' compares two things; without a comparison, use 'not very'.

cloze.sentence: This shirt is too ____ for me.

en_def: big in size or amount
hi_nuance: Slightly more formal than 'big'. Used for sizes in shops: small / medium / large. 'A large number of' = many. Ends in /dʒ/ like 'ज'.

examples.en: They have a large garden.
examples.hi: उनका बगीचा बड़ा है।

examples.en: Do you have this in a large size?
examples.hi: क्या यह बड़े साइज़ में है?

examples.en: A large number of people attended.
examples.hi: बड़ी संख्या में लोग शामिल हुए।

examples.en: The company has a large office in Pune.
examples.hi: कंपनी का पुणे में एक बड़ा दफ़्तर है।

examples.en: Please order a large pizza.
examples.hi: कृपया एक बड़ा पिज़्ज़ा ऑर्डर करो।

common_mistake.wrong: A large amount of people came.
common_mistake.right: A large number of people came.
common_mistake.why: 'Amount' is for uncountable nouns; 'people' is countable, so use 'number'.

cloze.sentence: I'd like a ____ coffee, please.

en_def: coming immediately after; nearest
hi_nuance: 'Next week/month' — no 'the' or 'in'. 'Next to' = beside. 'The next day' = the following day in a story. Pronounce the cluster /kst/ fully.

examples.en: See you next Monday.
examples.hi: अगले सोमवार मिलते हैं।

examples.en: Who is next?
examples.hi: अगला कौन है?

examples.en: The bank is next to the post office.
examples.hi: बैंक डाकघर के बगल में है।

examples.en: What should we do next?
examples.hi: अब हमें क्या करना चाहिए?

examples.en: Turn to the next page.
examples.hi: अगले पृष्ठ पर जाओ।

common_mistake.wrong: I will meet you on next Friday.
common_mistake.right: I will meet you next Friday.
common_mistake.why: 'Next' + day/week/month takes no preposition.

cloze.sentence: The ____ train arrives in ten minutes.

en_def: before the usual or expected time; near the beginning
hi_nuance: Long /ɜː/ vowel: ER-ly, not 'air-ly'. 'Early' is both adjective and adverb: 'an early train', 'wake up early'. 'Early morning' = the first hours of the morning.

examples.en: I wake up early every day.
examples.hi: मैं रोज़ जल्दी उठता हूँ।

examples.en: We arrived early for the interview.
examples.hi: हम इंटरव्यू के लिए जल्दी पहुँच गए।

examples.en: She left in the early morning.
examples.hi: वह सुबह-सुबह निकल गई।

examples.en: It's too early to decide.
examples.hi: फ़ैसला लेना अभी जल्दबाज़ी होगी।

examples.en: The early bird catches the worm.
examples.hi: जो जल्दी उठता है वही पाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please come fastly, we are getting late.
common_mistake.right: Please come quickly, we're running late.
common_mistake.why: 'Fastly' does not exist; the adverb is 'fast' or 'quickly'.

cloze.sentence: Let's leave ____ to avoid traffic.

en_def: having lived for only a short time; not old
hi_nuance: Starts with /j/ like 'yes' and has the /ʌ/ vowel of 'cup'. 'My younger brother' — not 'my small brother'. 'The young' = young people in general.

examples.en: She is too young to drive.
examples.hi: वह गाड़ी चलाने के लिए बहुत छोटी है।

examples.en: My younger brother is a student.
examples.hi: मेरा छोटा भाई छात्र है।

examples.en: He looks very young for his age.
examples.hi: वह अपनी उम्र के हिसाब से बहुत जवान दिखता है।

examples.en: When I was young, we had no internet.
examples.hi: जब मैं छोटा था, हमारे पास इंटरनेट नहीं था।

examples.en: Young people love this app.
examples.hi: युवा लोग इस ऐप को बहुत पसंद करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My small brother is ten years old.
common_mistake.right: My younger brother is ten years old.
common_mistake.why: For age, use 'younger'; 'small' refers to size.

cloze.sentence: He started his company when he was very ____.

en_def: having a great effect or value; needing attention
hi_nuance: Stress the second syllable: im-POR-tant. 'Important to' someone, 'important for' a purpose. 'It is important that…' is common in formal English.

examples.en: This is an important meeting.
examples.hi: यह एक महत्वपूर्ण बैठक है।

examples.en: Family is very important to me.
examples.hi: परिवार मेरे लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

examples.en: It's important to back up your data.
examples.hi: अपने डेटा का बैकअप लेना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: Sleep is important for your health.
examples.hi: नींद आपके स्वास्थ्य के लिए ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: What is the most important thing?
examples.hi: सबसे महत्वपूर्ण बात क्या है?

common_mistake.wrong: It is very much important for me.
common_mistake.right: It is very important to me.
common_mistake.why: 'Very much' is not used before adjectives, and 'important to' someone is the correct preposition.

cloze.sentence: It is ____ to lock your screen.

en_def: a small number of (countable things)
hi_nuance: 'A few' = some (positive); 'few' = hardly any (negative). Used only with countable plurals: 'a few friends'. For uncountable, use 'a little'. Begins with /fj/ — 'fyoo'.

examples.en: I have a few questions.
examples.hi: मेरे कुछ सवाल हैं।

examples.en: Few people came to the meeting.
examples.hi: बैठक में बहुत कम लोग आए।

examples.en: Let's wait a few minutes.
examples.hi: चलो कुछ मिनट इंतज़ार करते हैं।

examples.en: She knows a few words of Hindi.
examples.hi: वह हिन्दी के कुछ शब्द जानती है।

examples.en: Only a few tickets are left.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ कुछ टिकट बचे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I have few friends, so I am never alone.
common_mistake.right: I have a few friends, so I am never alone.
common_mistake.why: 'Few' means almost none; 'a few' means some.

cloze.sentence: I'll be back in a ____ minutes.

en_def: for or about everyone in a community; not private
hi_nuance: Stress the first syllable: PUB-lic. 'In public' = where others can see. 'The public' = people in general. 'Public transport' — not 'public transportation' in British English.

examples.en: I use public transport to get to work.
examples.hi: मैं काम पर जाने के लिए सार्वजनिक परिवहन का उपयोग करता हूँ।

examples.en: This is a public park.
examples.hi: यह एक सार्वजनिक पार्क है।

examples.en: He doesn't like speaking in public.
examples.hi: उसे सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलना पसंद नहीं है।

examples.en: The report is now public.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट अब सार्वजनिक है।

examples.en: Never share passwords on public Wi-Fi.
examples.hi: सार्वजनिक वाई-फ़ाई पर कभी पासवर्ड साझा न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Public are angry about the prices.
common_mistake.right: The public is angry about the prices.
common_mistake.why: 'The public' needs the article, and takes a singular verb in careful English.

cloze.sentence: Is tomorrow a ____ holiday?

en_def: not good; of low quality; harmful
hi_nuance: Vowel /æ/ — open the mouth wider than for Hindi 'ए'; 'bad' and 'bed' are different words. Comparative 'worse', superlative 'worst' — not 'badder'. 'Bad at' + skill.

examples.en: The weather is bad today.
examples.hi: आज मौसम ख़राब है।

examples.en: I am bad at remembering names.
examples.hi: मैं नाम याद रखने में कमज़ोर हूँ।

examples.en: Smoking is bad for your health.
examples.hi: धूम्रपान आपके स्वास्थ्य के लिए बुरा है।

examples.en: That's not a bad idea.
examples.hi: यह कोई बुरा विचार नहीं है।

examples.en: The milk has gone bad.
examples.hi: दूध ख़राब हो गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: This phone is more bad than my old one.
common_mistake.right: This phone is worse than my old one.
common_mistake.why: 'Bad' has the irregular comparative 'worse'.

cloze.sentence: Eating late at night is ____ for you.

en_def: exactly like another; not different
hi_nuance: Always 'the same', with the article. 'The same as', not 'the same like' or 'same to'. Don't use 'the same' as a pronoun for 'it' in emails ('please send the same').

examples.en: We go to the same school.
examples.hi: हम एक ही स्कूल में जाते हैं।

examples.en: Your phone is the same as mine.
examples.hi: आपका फ़ोन मेरे फ़ोन जैसा ही है।

examples.en: I'll have the same, please.
examples.hi: मुझे भी वही चाहिए, कृपया।

examples.en: It's the same problem again.
examples.hi: फिर वही समस्या है।

examples.en: Same to you!
examples.hi: आपको भी!

common_mistake.wrong: Please find attached the invoice and confirm the same.
common_mistake.right: Please find the invoice attached and confirm it.
common_mistake.why: 'The same' as a pronoun for 'it' is Indian business English; use 'it'.

cloze.sentence: We arrived at the ____ time.

en_def: having the skill or possibility to do something
hi_nuance: 'Be able to' + verb is the alternative to 'can' in tenses where 'can' doesn't work: 'I will be able to', 'I have been able to'. Never 'able for doing'.

examples.en: I wasn't able to sleep last night.
examples.hi: मैं कल रात सो नहीं पाया।

examples.en: She is able to speak four languages.
examples.hi: वह चार भाषाएँ बोल सकती है।

examples.en: Will you be able to come tomorrow?
examples.hi: क्या आप कल आ पाएँगे?

examples.en: He was able to fix the bug quickly.
examples.hi: वह बग को जल्दी ठीक कर पाया।

examples.en: I haven't been able to reach him.
examples.hi: मैं उससे संपर्क नहीं कर पाया हूँ।

collocations: as soon as I am able

common_mistake.wrong: I am not able for coming today.
common_mistake.right: I am not able to come today.
common_mistake.why: 'Able' is followed by 'to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: Were you ____ to finish the report?

en_def: before now; earlier than expected
hi_nuance: Used with the present perfect: 'I have already eaten'. Goes between 'have' and the verb, or at the end. Not 'I already ate yesterday' — 'already' and a past time word don't go together. One word, one 'l' in the middle.

examples.en: I have already finished my work.
examples.hi: मैंने अपना काम पहले ही ख़त्म कर लिया है।

examples.en: She has already left.
examples.hi: वह पहले ही जा चुकी है।

examples.en: Is it ten o'clock already?
examples.hi: क्या दस बज गए?

examples.en: We already know the answer.
examples.hi: हमें जवाब पहले से पता है।

examples.en: Have you already sent the email?
examples.hi: क्या आपने ईमेल पहले ही भेज दिया?

common_mistake.wrong: I already told him yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I told him yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'Already' is not needed with a specific past time like 'yesterday'.

cloze.sentence: Don't worry, I have ____ paid the bill.

en_def: continuing until now; even so
hi_nuance: 'Still' = the situation continues: 'I still live here'. 'Yet' = not until now: 'He hasn't come yet'. Hindi 'अभी तक' covers both — choose carefully. Position: before the main verb, after 'be'.

examples.en: I still live with my parents.
examples.hi: मैं अभी भी अपने माता-पिता के साथ रहता हूँ।

examples.en: Are you still working?
examples.hi: क्या आप अभी भी काम कर रहे हैं?

examples.en: It's late, but the shop is still open.
examples.hi: देर हो गई है, लेकिन दुकान अभी भी खुली है।

examples.en: He is tired, but he still wants to go.
examples.hi: वह थका है, फिर भी जाना चाहता है।

examples.en: Do you still have my book?
examples.hi: क्या मेरी किताब अभी भी आपके पास है?

common_mistake.wrong: He has not still replied.
common_mistake.right: He still hasn't replied.
common_mistake.why: 'Still' goes before 'hasn't' in negative sentences.

cloze.sentence: Is she ____ at the office?

en_def: as much or as many as needed
hi_nuance: Pronounced /ɪˈnʌf/ — the 'gh' is /f/. Goes BEFORE nouns ('enough time') but AFTER adjectives ('big enough'). 'Enough of' only before 'the/this/my'.

examples.en: We don't have enough time.
examples.hi: हमारे पास काफ़ी समय नहीं है।

examples.en: This room is big enough for everyone.
examples.hi: यह कमरा सबके लिए काफ़ी बड़ा है।

examples.en: Have you had enough to eat?
examples.hi: क्या आपने भरपेट खा लिया?

examples.en: He is old enough to decide.
examples.hi: वह फ़ैसला लेने के लिए काफ़ी बड़ा है।

examples.en: That's enough, thank you.
examples.hi: बस इतना काफ़ी है, धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: The bag is enough big.
common_mistake.right: The bag is big enough.
common_mistake.why: 'Enough' comes after an adjective.

cloze.sentence: Do we have ____ chairs for everyone?

en_def: at all times; every time
hi_nuance: Position: before the main verb ('I always walk') but after 'be' ('She is always late'). Don't put it at the start of the sentence. Present continuous + 'always' expresses annoyance: 'He is always complaining'.

examples.en: I always drink tea in the morning.
examples.hi: मैं हमेशा सुबह चाय पीता हूँ।

examples.en: She is always on time.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा समय पर होती है।

examples.en: You can always call me.
examples.hi: आप मुझे हमेशा फ़ोन कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: He always forgets his keys.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा अपनी चाबियाँ भूल जाता है।

examples.en: We have always lived here.
examples.hi: हम हमेशा से यहीं रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Always I take the bus to work.
common_mistake.right: I always take the bus to work.
common_mistake.why: 'Always' goes between the subject and the main verb.

cloze.sentence: She ____ helps her neighbours.

en_def: not at any time; not ever
hi_nuance: 'Never' is already negative — don't add 'not': 'I never eat meat', not 'I don't never'. Same position rules as 'always'. Use with present perfect for life experience: 'I have never been abroad'.

examples.en: I never eat meat.
examples.hi: मैं कभी माँस नहीं खाता।

examples.en: She has never been to Delhi.
examples.hi: वह कभी दिल्ली नहीं गई है।

examples.en: Never share your password.
examples.hi: अपना पासवर्ड कभी साझा न करें।

examples.en: He never listens to me.
examples.hi: वह मेरी बात कभी नहीं सुनता।

examples.en: It's never too late to learn.
examples.hi: सीखने के लिए कभी देर नहीं होती।

common_mistake.wrong: I didn't never see this error before.
common_mistake.right: I have never seen this error before.
common_mistake.why: 'Never' is negative by itself; don't combine it with 'not'.

cloze.sentence: I have ____ tried sushi.

en_def: many times; frequently
hi_nuance: The 't' is usually silent: /ˈɒfən/ (OFF-en). 'How often?' asks about frequency. Position: before the main verb. 'Very often', 'quite often' are natural.

examples.en: I often work late.
examples.hi: मैं अक्सर देर तक काम करता हूँ।

examples.en: How often do you exercise?
examples.hi: आप कितनी बार व्यायाम करते हैं?

examples.en: We don't see each other very often.
examples.hi: हम एक-दूसरे से बहुत कम मिलते हैं।

examples.en: She often visits her grandmother.
examples.hi: वह अक्सर अपनी दादी से मिलने जाती है।

examples.en: It often rains in July.
examples.hi: जुलाई में अक्सर बारिश होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I go often to the gym.
common_mistake.right: I often go to the gym.
common_mistake.why: 'Often' goes before the main verb.

cloze.sentence: How ____ do you visit your hometown?

en_def: on some occasions but not always
hi_nuance: One word. Flexible position: start, middle, or end of the sentence. 'Sometimes' (कभी-कभी) is not 'some time' (कुछ समय) or 'sometime' (किसी समय future).

examples.en: Sometimes I work from home.
examples.hi: कभी-कभी मैं घर से काम करता हूँ।

examples.en: We sometimes eat out on Fridays.
examples.hi: हम कभी-कभी शुक्रवार को बाहर खाते हैं।

examples.en: The internet is slow sometimes.
examples.hi: इंटरनेट कभी-कभी धीमा होता है।

examples.en: She sometimes forgets to reply.
examples.hi: वह कभी-कभी जवाब देना भूल जाती है।

examples.en: Sometimes it's better to wait.
examples.hi: कभी-कभी इंतज़ार करना बेहतर होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I need some times to think.
common_mistake.right: I need some time to think.
common_mistake.why: 'Some time' (two words) means a period; 'sometimes' means occasionally.

cloze.sentence: I ____ take the train instead of the bus.

en_def: to a great degree; extremely
hi_nuance: Starts with /v/ — teeth on lip — not /w/ ('wery'). Not used with 'too' ('very too much'). Don't use 'very' before strong adjectives like 'excellent' or 'huge'; use 'really' or nothing.

examples.en: It is very hot today.
examples.hi: आज बहुत गर्मी है।
